AMEND — one exact contradiction on aadc30d3e81052c1e683937347d8a3b9c5ca590ee166fa83a2af5cbdfafb6c9e. Digest matched before and after the full read; 1055 lines, 8432 words, 63459 bytes. Amendment 6 URL scope and Amendment 5 parent-cleanup safety remain byte-present and coherent.

The new `decoder identity` field is not yet derived from what it describes. The spec at the result-root minimum names decoder identity plus a decode receipt, but no construction law requires the identity to be derived from the admitted decoder authority or to equal a decoder identity bound inside that receipt. C2 says to verify both, but its killing mutations do not alter the decoder label while holding the actual decode and receipt fixed.

The current referenced implementation demonstrates the reachable lie. In `/private/tmp/story-output-prototype.WvQYKC/acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/output.scala`, `DecodedSourceIdentity.fromText(text, decoder, decodeReceipt)` accepts a caller-supplied opaque `DecoderId`; `DecodedSourceIdentity.of(decoder, length, checksum, receipt)` rejects only negative length. In `codec/output_acquire.scala`, the decoder reads the wire `decoder` field and passes it directly to that factory. `SourceIdentities.fromStorySource` and its wire factory repeat the same free decoder parameter. Therefore changing only `strict-utf8/v1` to another valid label while retaining the exact original bytes, selected charset/BOM, decoded text/length/checksum, and decode receipt still constructs and round-trips. The field is authoritative decoration.

Required repair: specify that decoder identity is derived from the admitted decoder implementation/policy/configuration and is bound by the typed decode receipt; checked construction and wire reconstruction must reject any mismatch, with no caller-selected parallel label. Add a C2 mutation that changes only decoder identity while fixing bytes, selected charset/BOM, decoded content/checksum, and receipt; it must fail. If the receipt remains only an opaque `OutputReceiptId`, name the resolvable typed receipt or embedded binding that makes this check possible offline.

This AMEND is specification review only. It accepts no implementation, dependency, vocabulary, candidate, or landing, and changes no shared path.
